definitions.gloss: voter turnout; voting rate; percentage of eligible voters who cast ballots
definitions.explanation: The proportion of eligible voters who actually vote in an election, expressed as a percentage.

examples.japanese: {投票率|とうひょうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投票率|とうひょうりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧50%だった。
examples.english: The voter turnout for this election was about 50%.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投票率|とうひょうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Initiatives are being undertaken to raise the voter turnout among young people.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧ (voting) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate/ratio). A common term in news and political discussions, especially around election time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投票率|とうひょうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ — high voter turnout
- {投票率|とうひょうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ — low voter turnout
- {投票率|とうひょうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ — to raise voter turnout
- {投票率|とうひょうりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧ — decline in voter turnout
- {過去最低|かこさいてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投票率|とうひょうりつ} — record-low voter turnout

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has seen a general trend of declining voter turnout, particularly among younger voters. National elections typically see turnout around 50-60%, while local elections can be significantly lower. This has been a persistent concern in Japanese political discourse.
